surface.encoding: R,G = 16-bit W; B = depth proxy 0.1 m steps

season.encoding: season = wet-season RESPONSE in 0..1, NOT a wetness flag. Standing-pool components are scaled to their own headroom (rim - level)/amplitudeM, where the rim is the median raw ground on the ring outside the pool, so the unchanged runtime lift can never carry a pool over its own shore. Rivers, marsh sheets and the sea keep response 1.
